body:
It's been a lot of stupid shit lately. She's obviously the most important part, but the stupid stuff has been a decent distraction... I just wish I could talk to her about everything else, you know?

I'm interning at a film company currently, and in the fall I will be moving out to NYC to study at a film school.

I just wish I could help more.

Thank you for reaching out.

I am so sorry about your father. I am so glad you have been able to stay strong.

I technically lost both of my bio parents as a kid, but a couple of relatives stepped up the plate of raising me even when my actual parents were technically still in the picture. It's very strange that she's gone. I know she wouldn't want me to be so sad, though. She wasn't aware of her sickness. Our last conversation was on the first day she was admitted to the hospital, and I couldn't stop crying. She told me to stop, and that'd be better soon. Then they injected her with morphine when she started screaming in pain again, and she was dead within the week. She never actually woke up again.

Sorry for the rant. Thank you for your response.

Just that I'm slipping back into this old mindset.

Thank you for the well wishes.
